review_notes: Two waws in this verse are rendered by the postpositive *also* (s001, s041) under rule 51; the ASV's *and*s at t012, t016, t031, t037 and t057 are each matched to the waw standing between the same items.

The repeated *in* of *in the second year ... and in the third* is read as one distributed preposition (rule 25); the competing reading would supply a second `בְּ` the Hebrew does not write and leave t058 `added`.
`זֹאת` → *So much* is headed on *much* under rule 24's fixed-phrase clause, since neither English word realizes the demonstrative's lexeme.
Both `לְ` datives are read on their own terms: s014 is silenced by the bare English indirect object *gave him* (rule 40) while s037 takes the written *unto*.
